name: Leviathan Deep

civilization.name: The Abyssal Choir
civilization.notes: Cetacean-analogues with distributed neural networks spanning multiple individuals. Communicate through subsonic frequencies that travel planet-wide through the ocean.

geological_features: Volcanic island chains forming the only above-water land, covering less than 0.3% of the surface
An ocean trench system reaching 58km in depth
Coral-analogue reef structures spanning thousands of kilometers
specific_features: Geometric arrangements of boulders on the ocean floor consistent with deliberate placement
Subsonic communication signals detectable through the planet's crust
resources: Coral-analogue materials with tensile strength exceeding steel
Rare biological compounds from deep-trench organisms
description: Leviathan Deep is a world almost entirely claimed by its ocean. The volcanic islands that dot its surface are little more than mountain peaks poking above the waterline, their black sand beaches pounded by swells born thousands of kilometers away. Below the surface, the ocean descends to depths that dwarf anything in the human catalog, its trenches reaching nearly sixty kilometers down into a world of crushing pressure and perpetual night.

The atmosphere is breathable and heavily humid, saturated with sea salt that coats every surface with a white crystalline film within hours of exposure. The weather is dominated by maritime cycles of mist, rain, and occasional typhoons of staggering intensity. But it is the sound that defines the experience of Leviathan Deep, a constant low-frequency vibration felt more than heard, rising from the ocean like the breathing of the planet itself. The subsonic pulses carry structured information across the entire globe.

The Abyssal Choir is not a single organism but a distributed intelligence spanning thousands of cetacean-analogue individuals. Their neural architecture allows direct electrochemical connection when they swim in close formation, creating a temporary composite mind of enormous processing power. The geometric boulder arrangements on the ocean floor appear to be their equivalent of architecture or art, repositioned over generations into patterns that may encode their collective memory. They are aware of the surface and the islands but show no interest in either.

The contact situation at Leviathan Deep is unprecedented. The Abyssal Choir does not think individually in any way recognizable to human cognition, making communication protocols designed for discrete entities essentially useless. Their subsonic transmissions contain information density that exceeds human speech by orders of magnitude, but decoding requires understanding a fundamentally alien cognitive framework. Meanwhile, the coral-analogue materials have attracted engineering interest that the quarantine authority struggles to suppress.
